checks.title: Configuration management in place
checks.description: Verify configuration management identifies baselines, items, and ensures integrity of safety artifacts.

checks.title: Change management process
checks.description: Confirm change management evaluates safety impact and maintains traceability.

checks.title: Software tool qualification (if needed)
checks.description: Check tool qualification evidence exists where tool confidence level requires it.

checks.title: Proven-in-use argument (if applied)
checks.description: If PIU used, verify operational history, environment equivalence, and failure data support the claim.

checks.title: Documentation management and retention
checks.description: Ensure documentation is controlled, reviewed, and retained to support assessments.

checks.title: Verification and validation evidence
checks.description: Confirm V&V activities planned and results recorded with objective evidence.
